skill.name: comprehensive-review-pr-enhance
skill.description: Create clear pull request descriptions, review checklists, risk notes, and test summaries for software changes.
skill.summary: Creates structured pull request documentation and reviewer guidance for software changes.

content.value_statement: Pull requests often lack context, test evidence, and reviewer guidance. This skill creates structured PR material that helps reviewers act faster.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes a diff into scope, intent, and key changes.
Generates PR descriptions with tests, risks, and rollout notes.
Creates reviewer checklists based on changed file types.
Suggests ways to split large pull requests into smaller units.
Drafts review response templates for common reviewer feedback.
Adds architecture or coverage sections when the change data supports them.
limitations: It depends on accurate diff, commit, and test information from the user or workspace.
It does not replace a full code review or security review.
Coverage and risk sections need project tools or supplied metrics.
Generated PR text still needs owner review before publishing.

use_cases.title: Prepare a feature PR
use_cases.description: Create a complete PR description with summary, implementation notes, test evidence, and reviewer focus areas.

use_cases.title: Standardize team reviews
use_cases.description: Generate consistent checklists and risk notes so reviewers evaluate changes with shared expectations.

use_cases.title: Reduce large PR friction
use_cases.description: Identify when a change is hard to review and suggest logical smaller pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a basic PR description
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: use when you have a small change and need a clear first draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a PR description for my current changes. Include summary, what changed, tests, and reviewer notes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: use when a PR already exists but lacks structure or detail.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this PR description for clarity and reviewability. Keep the intent, add missing risks, and make the test section specific.

prompt_templates.title: Create reviewer guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use when a change touches several areas and reviewers need focus points.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this change list and create reviewer guidance. Group files by concern, list risk areas, and suggest review order.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a large PR split
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use when a branch is too large for efficient review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this pull request for size and review risk. Propose smaller PRs with scope, order, and validation notes for each.

output_examples.input: A feature branch adds account settings, updates tests, and changes configuration defaults.
output: PR summary that explains the user-facing settings change.
Grouped change list for source, tests, and configuration files.
Testing section with unit tests, manual checks, and configuration risks.
Reviewer notes that call out default behavior changes.

output_examples.input: A large refactor touches shared services, UI components, and integration tests.
output: Risk assessment that flags broad shared-service impact.
Suggested split into service, UI, and test follow-up pull requests.
Review checklist focused on compatibility, regression risk, and rollback.

best_practices: Provide the diff, related issue, test results, and deployment context before asking for PR text.
Ask for reviewer focus areas when the change touches multiple systems.
Review generated claims against actual tests and metrics before posting the PR.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to hide missing tests, known risks, or unresolved review concerns.
Do not ask it to invent coverage numbers, benchmarks, or deployment results.
Do not treat the generated checklist as a substitute for human review.

faq.question: Can this skill write a complete PR description?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft summary, scope, test evidence, risks, rollout notes, and reviewer guidance from supplied change context.

faq.question: Does it run tests or inspect my repository automatically?
faq.answer: No. It needs tool output, diffs, or metrics from the user or workspace to describe tests accurately.

faq.question: Can it help split a large pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. It can group changes by feature area and suggest smaller reviewable pull requests.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it replace a code review?
faq.answer: No. It improves PR documentation and reviewer guidance, but reviewers still need to inspect the actual code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the diff, commit purpose, test results, risk areas, related issue, and any release notes.
